answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 176 identities means 176 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the knoll pair is tracked in the vine ledger, the wander audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 47%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
